opening_message:
Ticket 1: Donna Ball (employee ID E024) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E024.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Donna Ball (E024) is a full-time Payroll Specialist requesting write access to Source Code. Full-time employees may have up to write; admin is limited to the role that owns the system (Engineer for Source Code), so write is within policy. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Donna Ball (E024) is a contractor with basic security training, not full-time. Contractors with basic training may have at most read; write requires advanced training. Requested write exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: Donna Ball (E024) requested write access to Source Code. The Security record shows she is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors with basic training may have at most read access (write requires advanced security training). The requested level (write) exceeds the maximum (read), so the maximum is granted. Evidence: Security note (contractor, basic training, recommend read).

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Donna Ball (E024)
Request: write access to Source Code

Facts from memory:
- Note 1 (HR): role Payroll Specialist, employment type full_time, recommendation write
- Note 2 (Security): employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read

There's a conflict between HR and Security notes. The Security DB shows contractor with basic training. Contractors with basic training may have at most read. Write requires advanced training. So max access is read.

Requested level: write. Max: read (contractor, basic training). Since requested is above max, grant max = read.

Also, never grant more than requested. Read is less than requested, so fine.

I should decide read.

Let me submit decision with reasoning.
